candidates.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
candidates.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

candidates.title: Structured outputs for Anthropic Claude models on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Amazon Bedrock now supports structured outputs for all Anthropic Claude models on both the bedrock-runtime and bedrock-mantle endpoints. Receive schema-compliant JSON that conforms to a defined structure, without custom parsing, retry logic, or post-processing, using JSON Schema output format and strict tool use.

candidates.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
candidates.summary: An independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee cut menu repricing time by 95% and built a workflow that could free up $100K in cash flow.

candidates.title: How Eon built multi-cloud investigation with an MCP Gateway on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Learn how Eon replaced per-tool credentials and local MCP processes across AWS, GCP, and Azure with a single authenticated Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway, giving more than 100 developers and autonomous agents unified access to production investigation and cutting new-engineer onboarding from two days to two minutes.

candidates.title: Otter AI raises $320M from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
candidates.summary: Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation.

candidates.title: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
candidates.summary: Terminal X’s Eval Agent grades outputs against a 54-criterion rubric, catching 25% more deviances from a fund’s mandate with GPT-6.1 Sol.
